topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Who is currently responsible for estimating National Income in India?
te: భారతదేశంలో జాతీయ ఆదాయాన్ని అంచనా వేయడానికి ప్రస్తుతం ఎవరు బాధ్యత వహిస్తారు?
exp: The National Statistical Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) is responsible for estimating the national income in India.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Which of the following is deducted from Gross National Product (GNP) to get Net National Product (NNP)?
te: స్థూల జాతీయ ఉత్పత్తి (GNP) నుండి నికర జాతీయ ఉత్పత్తి (NNP)ని పొందడానికి క్రింది వాటిలో దేనిని తీసివేస్తారు?
exp: NNP is obtained by subtracting depreciation (consumption of fixed capital) from GNP.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: What is the primary sector of the Indian economy mainly composed of?
te: భారతీయ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థ యొక్క ప్రాథమిక రంగం ప్రధానంగా దేనిని కలిగి ఉంటుంది?
exp: The primary sector includes agriculture, forestry, fishing, and mining, which are directly dependent on the use of natural resources.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Per Capita Income is calculated by dividing the National Income by:
te: తలసరి ఆదాయాన్ని జాతీయ ఆదాయాన్ని దేనితో భాగించడం ద్వారా లెక్కարկిస్తారు?
exp: Per Capita Income is the average income of the people in a country, calculated by dividing total national income by the total population.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Which sector currently contributes the largest share to India's Gross Value Added (GVA)?
te: ప్రస్తుతం భారతదేశం యొక్క స్థూల విలువ జోడింపు (GVA)కి అత్యధిక వాటాను అందిస్తున్న రంగం ఏది?
exp: The tertiary or service sector is the largest sector in India, contributing more than 50% to the country's GVA.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Who publishes the Human Development Report (HDR) which includes the Human Development Index (HDI)?
te: హ్యూమన్ డెవలప్‌మెంట్ ఇండెక్స్ (HDI)ని కలిగి ఉన్న హ్యూమన్ డెవలప్‌మెంట్ రిపోర్ట్ (HDR)ను ఎవరు ప్రచురిస్తారు?
opts: International Monetary Fund - IMF (అంతర్జాతీయ ద్రవ్య నిధి)
United Nations Development Programme - UNDP (ఐక్యరాజ్యసమితి అభివృద్ధి కార్యక్రమం)
World Health Organization - WHO (ప్రపంచ ఆరోగ్య సంస్థ)
exp: The Human Development Report has been published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) since 1990.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Which of the following dimensions is NOT used to calculate the Human Development Index (HDI)?
te: కింది వాటిలో మానవ అభివృద్ధి సూచిక (HDI) లెక్కించడానికి ఉపయోగించని పరిమాణం ఏది?
opts: A long and healthy life (దీర్ఘకాలిక మరియు ఆరోగ్యకరమైన జీవితం)
A decent standard of living (మంచి జీవన ప్రమాణం)
exp: HDI uses three dimensions: health (life expectancy), education (mean and expected years of schooling), and standard of living (GNI per capita).

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: What type of unemployment is commonly found in the agricultural sector of developing countries like India, where more people are engaged in an activity than actually required?
te: భారతదేశం వంటి అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న దేశాల వ్యవసాయ రంగంలో, వాస్తవానికి అవసరమైనదాని కంటే ఎక్కువ మంది నిమగ్నమై ఉండే సాధారణ నిరుద్యోగ రకం ఏమిటి?
exp: Disguised unemployment occurs when marginal productivity of labor is zero or negative, frequently seen in Indian agriculture.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Inclusive growth generally implies:
te: సమ్మిళిత వృద్ధి సాధారణంగా దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది?
opts: Growth focused only on the industrial sector (పారిశ్రామిక రంగంపై మాత్రమే దృష్టి పెట్టిన వృద్ధి)
Growth that ensures economic benefits are shared equitably across all sections of society (సమాజంలోని అన్ని వర్గాల మధ్య ఆర్థిక ప్రయోజనాలు సమానంగా పంపిణీ చేయబడే వృద్ధి)
Growth achieved through high inflation (అధిక ద్రవ్యోల్బణం ద్వారా సాధించిన వృద్ధి)
Growth limited to urban areas only (పట్టణ ప్రాంతాలకు మాత్రమే పరిమితమైన వృద్ధి)
exp: Inclusive growth means economic growth that creates employment opportunities and ensures widespread benefits shared equitably by all members of society.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Poverty estimation in India is historically based on which criteria recommended by various expert committees?
te: భారతదేశంలో పేదరిక అంచనా చారిత్రాత్మకంగా వివిధ నిపుణుల కమిటీలు సిఫార్సు చేసిన ఏ ప్రమాణాలపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది?
opts: Calorie intake / Consumption expenditure (కేలోరీ వినియోగం / వినియోగ వ్యయం)
Number of vehicles owned (కలిగి ఉన్న వాహనాల సంఖ్య)
Access to social media (సోషల్ మీడియా యాక్సెస్)
exp: Traditionally, poverty lines in India (like Tendulkar and Lakdawala committees) have been estimated using monthly per capita consumption expenditure (MPCE) based on calorie requirements.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: When was NITI Aayog established replacing the Planning Commission?
te: ప్రణాళికా సంఘం స్థానంలో నీతి ఆయోగ్ ఎప్పుడు ఏర్పాటు చేయబడింది?
exp: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) was established on January 1, 2015.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Who is the Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
te: నీతి ఆయోగ్ చైర్మన్ ఎవరు?
exp: The Prime Minister of India serves as the Chairperson of NITI Aayog.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: What type of tax is the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
te: భారతదేశంలో గూడ్స్ అండ్ సర్వీసెస్ ట్యాక్స్ (GST) ఏ రకమైన పన్ను?
exp: GST is a comprehensive indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services across India.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: What does Fiscal Deficit primarily indicate?
te: ద్రవ్య లోటు (Fiscal Deficit) ప్రధానంగా దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది?
exp: Fiscal deficit indicates the total borrowing requirements of the government to meet its expenditures.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Which of the following is the central bank of India responsible for financial sector regulations?
te: 금융 రంగ నిబంధనలకు బాధ్యత వహించే భారతదేశపు కేంద్ర బ్యాంకు ఏది?
exp: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central bank and regulates the financial and banking sector.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Who is known as the Father of the Green Revolution in India?
te: భారతదేశంలో హరిత విప్లవ పితామహుడిగా ఎవరిని పిలుస్తారు?
exp: M. S. Swaminathan is widely recognized as the scientific leader of the Green Revolution in India.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: What does MSP stand for in the context of Indian agriculture?
te: భారతీయ వ్యవసాయ రంగంలో MSP అనగా ఏమి?
exp: MSP stands for Minimum Support Price, which is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Which of the following is considered the apex institution for agricultural credit in India?
te: భారతదేశంలో వ్యవసాయ పరపతి కోసం అపెక్స్ (ఉన్నత) సంస్థగా క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది పరిగణించబడుతుంది?
exp: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) is the apex regulatory body for overall licensing and regulation of regional rural banks and apex cooperative banks in India.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Abolition of Zamindari system is an example of which type of reform?
te: జమీందారీ వ్యవస్థ రద్దు అనేది ఏ రకమైన సంస్కరణకు ఉదాహరణ?
exp: Land reforms primarily involve the redistribution of land and changes in the ownership of land, such as the abolition of intermediary systems like Zamindari.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: In which year was the National Food Security Act (NFSA) enacted in India?
te: భారతదేశంలో జాతీయ ఆహార భద్రతా చట్టం (NFSA) ఏ సంవత్సరంలో చేయబడింది?
exp: The National Food Security Act (NFSA) was enacted in India in the year 2013 to provide subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of India's population.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: In which year was the first comprehensive Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) announced in independent India?
te: स्वतंत्र இந்தியாவில் முதல் விரிவான தொழிற்கொள்கை தீர்மானம் (IPR) எந்த ஆண்டில் அறிவிக்கப்பட்டது?
exp: The first Industrial Policy Resolution of independent India was announced on April 6, 1948, laying the foundation of a mixed economy.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: What is the primary criteria currently used in India to classify enterprises as Micro, Small, or Medium (MSME)?
te: இந்தியாவில் நிறுவனங்களை நுண்ணிய, சிறு அல்லது நடுத்தர (MSME) என வகைப்படுத்த தற்போது பயன்படுத்தப்படும் முக்கிய வரம்பு என்ன?
exp: MSMEs in India are classified based on a composite criteria of both investment in plant and machinery/equipment and annual turnover.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: Which of the following is considered the apex body or software technology park authority promoting IT exports in India?
te: இந்தியாவில் ஐடி (IT) ஏற்றுமதியை ஊக்குவிக்கும் முக்கிய அமைப்பாக பின்வருவனவற்றில் எது கருதப்படுகிறது?
exp: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) that promotes software exports.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: What is the official tagline used by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, to promote tourism?
te: சுற்றுலாவை மேம்படுத்துவதற்காக இந்திய அரசின் சுற்றுலா அமைச்சகம் பயன்படுத்தும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வாசகம் என்ன?
exp: Incredible India is the international marketing campaign initiated by the Government of India to promote tourism in India.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: The landmark New Industrial Policy that introduced LPG (Liberalization, Privatization, Globalization) reforms was announced in which year?
te: எல்பிஜி (தாராளமயமாக்கல், தனியார்மயமாக்கல், உலகமயமாக்கல்) சீர்திருத்தங்களை அறிமுகப்படுத்திய வரலாற்றுச் சிறப்புமிக்க புதிய தொழிற்கொள்கை எந்த ஆண்டில் அறிவிக்கப்பட்டது?
exp: The New Industrial Policy of 1991 introduced sweeping reforms centered around Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization (LPG).

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Which system of land revenue was predominantly prevalent in the Khalsa (crown) lands during the Nizam rule in Hyderabad state?
te: హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్రంలో నిజాం పాలనలో ఖల్సా (రాజకీయ) భూములలో ఏ భూమి శిస్తు విధానం ఎక్కువగా అమల్లో ఉండేది?
exp: Under the Nizam rule, the Ryotwari system, also known as the Diwani system, was directly implemented in the Khalsa lands where the cultivator paid revenue directly to the government.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: What were the administrative divisions known as during the Nizam period in the Hyderabad State?
te: హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్రంలో నిజాం కాలంలో పరిపాలనా విభాగాలను ఏమని పిలిచేవారు?
exp: During the Nizam period, the state was divided into administrative units called Subas (provinces), which were further divided into districts (Zillas) and talukas.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Which of the following was a major cash crop promoted extensively during the late Nizam period in Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణలో నిజాం కాలం చివరి భాగంలో విస్తృతంగా ప్రోత్సహించబడిన ప్రధాన వాణిజ్య పంట క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది?
exp: Castor (Aamudalu) along with cotton and oilseeds were major cash crops grown in the Telangana region during the Nizam era due to the semi-arid soil conditions.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: The famous 'Mulki' regulations in the erstwhile Hyderabad State were primarily aimed at protecting the interests of whom?
te: గత హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్రంలో ప్రసిద్ధమైన 'ముల్కీ' నిబంధనల యొక్క ముఖ్య ఉద్దేశ్యం ఎవరి ప్రయోజనాలను పరిరక్షించడం?
exp: Mulki regulations were enacted to protect the employment and educational opportunities of the native subjects (local residents) of the Hyderabad State against outsiders.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Regional economic disparities in undivided Andhra Pradesh were prominently studied and highlighted by which committee?
te: ఉమ్మడి ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో ప్రాంతీయ ఆర్థిక అసమతుల్యతలను ప్రముఖంగా అధ్యయనం చేసి వెలుగులోకి తెచ్చిన కమిటీ ఏది?
exp: The Bhargava Committee (Committee on Regional Imbalances) was appointed by the Government of Andhra Pradesh to look into the regional disparities in development between coastal Andhra, Rayalaseema, and Telangana regions.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: What is the primary indicator used to measure the total economic output of Telangana state within its boundaries over a specific period?
te: निर्दिष्ट కాలంలో తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర సరిహద్దుల లోపల మొత్తం ఆర్థిక ఉత్పత్తిని కొలవడానికి ఉపయోగించే ప్రాథమిక సూచిక ఏమిటి?
exp: Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) is the total monetary value of all goods and services produced within the state's geographic boundaries during a given year.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Which sector generally contributes the largest share to Telangana's Gross State Value Added (GSVA)?
te: సాధారణంగా తెలంగాణ యొక్క స్థూల రాష్ట్ర విలువ జోడింపునకు (GSVA) అత్యధిక వాటాను అందించే రంగం ఏది?
exp: The Tertiary (Services) sector contributes the largest share to Telangana's economy and GSVA.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Per Capita Income of a state is calculated by dividing the Net State Domestic Product (NSDP) by:
te: ఒక రాష్ట్ర తలసరి ఆదాయాన్ని నికర రాష్ట్ర దేశీయ ఉత్పత్తిని (NSDP) దేనితో భాగించడం ద్వారా లెక్కిస్తారు?
exp: Per Capita Income is calculated by dividing the Net State Domestic Product (NSDP) by the total mid-year population of the state.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Structural transformation in an economy typically involves a shift of workforce and output from:
te: ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలో నిర్మాణ మార్పు (Structural transformation) సాధారణంగా శ్రామిక శక్తి మరియు ఉత్పత్తిలో దేని నుండి దేనికి మారడాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది?
exp: Structural transformation generally implies the transition of an economy away from dependence on agriculture towards industry and services.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Which sub-sector is a major component of the Primary Sector in Telangana's economy?
te: తెలంగాణ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలోని ప్రాథమిక రంగంలో ప్రధాన భాగం ఏది?
exp: Agriculture, livestock, forestry, and fishing constitute the primary sector (agriculture and allied activities) in Telangana.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: In which year was the landmark Andhra Pradesh (Telangana Area) Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act enacted?
te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ (తెలంగాణ ప్రాంత) కౌలు మరియు వ్యవసాయ భూముల చట్టం ఏ సంవత్సరంలో చేయబడింది?
exp: The Andhra Pradesh (Telangana Area) Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act was enacted in 1950 to protect tenants and regulate agricultural land relations.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: What was the primary objective of the Inams Abolition Act in the Telangana region?
te: తెలంగాణ ప్రాంతంలో ఇనాముల రద్దు చట్టం యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: To collect more taxes from farmers
To abolish intermediary tenure and establish a direct link between the tiller and the state
To distribute land only to big landlords
To promote industrialization in rural areas
exp: The Inams Abolition Act aimed at abolishing intermediary tenure systems (Inamdars) and establishing direct relations between the actual cultivators (tillers) and the government.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: What is the primary purpose of the Dharani portal launched by the Government of Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం ప్రారంభించిన ధరణి పోర్టల్ యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: Integrated land records management and registration
exp: Dharani is an integrated land records management and registration portal introduced to bring transparency and efficiency to land administration in Telangana.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: At the district level, who is the principal official responsible for land administration and revenue matters?
te: జిల్లా స్థాయిలో, భూ పరిపాలన మరియు రెవెన్యూ విషయాలకు బాధ్యత వహించే ప్రధాన అధికారి ఎవరు?
exp: The District Collector functions as the principal administrative head at the district level, overseeing land administration, revenue collection, and maintenance of land records.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: Which official at the mandal level is primarily responsible for maintaining village land records and revenue accounts?
te: గ్రామ భూ రికార్డులు మరియు రెవెన్యూ ఖాతాలను నిర్వహించడానికి మండల స్థాయిలో ఏ అధికారి ప్రధానంగా బాధ్యత వహిస్తారు?
exp: The Mandal Revenue Officer (MRO), also known as the Tahsildar, is responsible for land administration, revenue collection, and maintaining land records at the mandal level.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: What is the primary objective of the Mission Kakatiya program in Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణలో మిషన్ కాకతీయ కార్యక్రమం యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి?
opts: Restoration of minor irrigation tanks and lakes
Distribution of free seeds to farmers
exp: Mission Kakatiya aims at the restoration of minor irrigation tanks and lakes in Telangana to empower local communities and improve agriculture.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: The Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project (KLIP) primarily utilizes the waters of which river?
te: కాళేశ్వరం ఎత్తిపోతల పథకం (KLIP) ప్రధానంగా ఏ నది నీటిని వినియోగిస్తుంది?
exp: The Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project is a multi-purpose irrigation project on the Godavari River in Telangana.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: What is the main purpose of the Rythu Bandhu scheme introduced by the Government of Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం ప్రవేశపెట్టిన రైతు బంధు పథకం యొక్క ముఖ్య ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి?
opts: Providing investment support to farmers per acre
exp: Rythu Bandhu is a farmers' investment support scheme providing financial assistance per acre for two crops a year.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: Rythu Bima scheme in Telangana is related to which of the following?
te: తెలంగాణలోని రైతు బీమా పథకం కింది వాటిలో దానికి సంబంధించినది?
exp: Rythu Bima is a farmers' group life insurance scheme providing financial relief to the family in case of the farmer's death.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: In which year was the Rythu Bandhu scheme launched in Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణలో రైతు బంధు పథకం ఏ సంవత్సరంలో ప్రారంభించబడింది?
exp: The Rythu Bandhu scheme was officially launched in May 2018 to support farmers with investment.

topic: Industrial and Service Growth in Telangana: TS-iPASS, T-Hub, Pharma City, IT and Emerging Technologies
en: What does TS-iPASS stand for in Telangana's industrial policy framework?
te: తెలంగాణ పారిశ్రామిక విధానంలో TS-iPASS అనగా ఏమిటి?
opts: Telangana State Industrial Project Approval and Self Certification System
Telangana State Industrial Project and Single Window System
Telangana State Industrial Project Approval and Self Support System
Telangana State Industrial Policy and Single Support System
exp: TS-iPASS stands for Telangana State Industrial Project Approval and Self Certification System, aimed at swift approvals for industries.

topic: Industrial and Service Growth in Telangana: TS-iPASS, T-Hub, Pharma City, IT and Emerging Technologies
en: Which city in Telangana is hosting the development of the world's largest integrated Pharma City?
te: ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద ఇంటిగ్రేటెడ్ ఫార్మా సిటీ అభివృద్ధి తెలంగాణలోని ఏ ప్రాంతంలో జరుగుతోంది?
exp: Hyderabad is home to the Hyderabad Pharma City, envisioned as the world's largest integrated pharmaceutical cluster.

topic: Industrial and Service Growth in Telangana: TS-iPASS, T-Hub, Pharma City, IT and Emerging Technologies
en: What is the primary objective of T-Hub established in Hyderabad?
te: హైదరాబాద్‌లో ఏర్పాటు చేసిన టి-హబ్ (T-Hub) యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: To act as a startup incubator and innovation hub
exp: T-Hub is India's leading startup incubator and innovation ecosystem builder based in Hyderabad.

topic: Industrial and Service Growth in Telangana: TS-iPASS, T-Hub, Pharma City, IT and Emerging Technologies
en: Which sector has been the major contributor to Telangana's service sector growth and export earnings?
te: తెలంగాణ సేవల రంగ వృద్ధికి మరియు ఎగుమతి ఆదాయానికి ప్రధానంగా దోహదపడుతున్న రంగం ఏది?
exp: Information Technology (IT) and IT-enabled Services (ITES) are the major drivers of Telangana's service sector and exports.

topic: Industrial and Service Growth in Telangana: TS-iPASS, T-Hub, Pharma City, IT and Emerging Technologies
en: Under TS-iPASS, what is the maximum time limit for the approval of industrial licenses for non-mega projects?
te: TS-iPASS కింద, మెగా కాని ప్రాజెక్ట్‌లకు పారిశ్రామిక లైసెన్సుల ఆమోదం కోసం గరిష్ట సమయ పరిమితి ఎంత?
exp: TS-iPASS guarantees clearances within a statutory time limit of 30 days for non-mega projects, ensuring ease of doing business.

topic: Environment and Sustainable Development: Clean Energy, Carbon Footprint, Forest Policy and Bio-diversity
en: What is the primary greenhouse gas responsible for global warming and carbon footprints?
te: గ్లోబల్ వార్మింగ్ మరియు కార్బన్ పాదముద్రలకు బాధ్యత వహించే ప్రాథమిక గ్రీన్ హౌస్ వాయువు ఏది?
exp: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is the primary greenhouse gas emitted through human activities, mainly fossil fuel combustion, forming the basis of carbon footprint measurements.

topic: Environment and Sustainable Development: Clean Energy, Carbon Footprint, Forest Policy and Bio-diversity
en: Which of the following is considered a renewable or clean energy source?
te: కింది వాటిలో ఏది పునరుత్పాదక లేదా స్వచ్ఛమైన శక్తి వనరుగా పరిగణించబడుతుంది?
exp: Solar energy is harnessed from the sun and is inexhaustible and clean, unlike fossil fuels such as coal, petroleum, and natural gas.

topic: Environment and Sustainable Development: Clean Energy, Carbon Footprint, Forest Policy and Bio-diversity
en: What does Biodiversity refer to?
te: జీవవైవిధ్యం (Biodiversity) దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది?
opts: Variety of plant and animal life in a particular habitat (ఒక నిర్దిష్ట ఆవాసంలో మొక్కలు మరియు జంతువుల జీవిత వైవిధ్యం)
Total volume of water on Earth (భూమిపై మొత్తం నీటి పరిమాణం)
Amount of carbon in the atmosphere (వాతావరణంలో కార్బన్ పరిమాణం)
Speed of wind in a region (ఒక ప్రాంతంలో గాలి వేగం)
exp: Biodiversity refers to the variety and variability of life on Earth, encompassing all ecosystems, species, and genetic diversity.

topic: Environment and Sustainable Development: Clean Energy, Carbon Footprint, Forest Policy and Bio-diversity
en: As per the National Forest Policy of India, what percentage of the total geographical area should ideally be under forest and tree cover?
te: భారత జాతీయ అటవీ విధానం ప్రకారం, మొత్తం భౌగోళిక విస్తీర్ణంలో ఎంత శాతం అటవీ మరియు చెట్ల ఆవరణ కింద ఉండాలి?
exp: The National Forest Policy of India recommends maintaining a minimum of 33% of the total geographical area under forest and tree cover for ecological balance.

topic: Environment and Sustainable Development: Clean Energy, Carbon Footprint, Forest Policy and Bio-diversity
en: What is meant by 'Carbon Footprint'?
te: 'కార్బన్ పాదముద్ర' (Carbon Footprint) అనగా ఏమిటి?
opts: The physical footprint left by humans in forests (అడవులలో మానవులు విడిచిపెట్టే భౌగోళిక అడుగుజాడలు)
The total amount of greenhouse gases produced directly and indirectly by human activities (మానవ కార్యకలాపాల ద్వారా ప్రత్యక్షంగా మరియు పరోక్షంగా ఉత్పత్తి అయ్యే హరితగృహ వాయువుల మొత్తం)
The amount of carbon absorbed by rocks (రాళ్ల ద్వారా శోષించబడే కార్బన్)
The weight of coal consumed globally (ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా వినియోగించే బొగ్గు బరువు)
exp: A carbon footprint is the total greenhouse gas emissions caused directly and indirectly by an individual, organization, event, or product, typically measured in units of CO2 equivalent.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: What is the primary measure of the total output of goods and services produced within the country's domestic territory during a specific year?
te: ఒక నిర్దిష్ట సంవత్సరంలో దేశ దేశీయ భూభాగంలో ఉత్పత్తి చేయబడిన వస్తువులు మరియు సేవల మొత్తం ఉత్పత్తి యొక్క ప్రాథమిక కొలమానం ఏమిటి?
exp: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) measures the total value of all final goods and services produced within the domestic territory of a country during a given period.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Which organization in India is officially responsible for the estimation of National Income?
te: భారతదేశంలో జాతీయ ఆదాయాన్ని అంచనా వేయడానికి అధికారికంగా బాధ్యత వహించే సంస్థ ఏది?
exp: The National Statistical Office (NSO), formerly Central Statistics Office (CSO), under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation is responsible for calculating India's national income.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Net National Product (NNP) at Factor Cost is also known as:
te: కారక ఖర్చు (Factor Cost) వద్ద నికర జాతీయ ఉత్పత్తిని (NNP) ఏమని పిలుస్తారు?
exp: Net National Product (NNP) at factor cost is officially known as India's National Income.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: Which of the following sectors traditionally contributes the largest share to India's Gross Value Added (GVA) in recent decades?
te: சமீபத்திய தசாப்தங்களில் இந்தியாவின் மொத்த மதிப்பு সংযతத்திற்கு (GVA) பாரம்பரியமாக மிகப்பெரிய பங்களிப்பை வழங்கும் துறை எது?
exp: The Service Sector (Tertiary sector) contributes the largest share to India's GVA, accounting for over 50% of the total economic output.

topic: Indian Economy: Issues and Challenges - National Income, Trends, Measurement and Sectoral Shares
en: How is Per Capita Income of a country calculated?
te: ఒక దేశం యొక్క తలసరి ఆదాయం ఎలా లెక్కించబడుతుంది?
opts: Total GDP divided by Total Area
National Income divided by Total Population
Total Savings divided by Total Population
Total Consumption divided by Total Taxpayers
exp: Per Capita Income is calculated by dividing the total National Income of a country by its total population.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Which of the following dimensions are used to calculate the Human Development Index (HDI)?
te: మావన అభివృద్ధి సూచిక (HDI) లెక్కించడానికి క్రింది వాటిలో ఏ పరిమాణాలు ఉపయోగించబడతాయి?
opts: Health, Education, and Standard of Living
Per Capita Income, Population, and Area
exp: HDI is a composite statistic of life expectancy, education, and per capita income indicators, which are categorized into health, education, and standard of living.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: What type of unemployment is commonly found in the agricultural sector of developing countries like India, where marginal productivity of labour is zero?
te: భారతదేశం వంటి అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న దేశాల వ్యవసాయ రంగంలో, శ్రామిక ఉత్పాదకత సున్నాగా ఉండే ఏ రకమైన నిరుద్యోగం సాధారణంగా కనిపిస్తుంది?
exp: Disguised unemployment occurs when more people are employed in a job than are actually needed, commonly seen in Indian agriculture.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Who introduced the concept of the Human Development Index (HDI) in 1990?
te: 1990 లో మానవ అభివృద్ధి సూచిక (HDI) భావనను ఎవరు ప్రవేశపెట్టారు?
opts: Amartya Sen and Mahbub ul Haq
John Maynard Keynes and Milton Friedman
exp: The HDI was created by Pakistani economist Mahbub ul Haq and Indian economist Amartya Sen in 1990 for the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: Which of the following terms best describes economic growth that creates opportunity for all segments of the population and distributes the dividends of increased prosperity fairly?
te: జనాభాలోని అన్ని వర్గాలకు అవకాశాలను కల్పించే మరియు పెరిగిన సంపదను సమానంగా పంపిణీ చేసే ఆర్థిక వృద్ధిని క్రింది పదాలలో ఏది ఉత్తమంగా వర్ణిస్తుంది?
exp: Inclusive growth refers to economic growth that is distributed fairly across society and creates opportunities for all.

topic: Poverty, Unemployment, Human Development Index (HDI) and Inclusive Growth
en: In India, poverty lines are traditionally estimated based on consumption expenditure rather than income. Why?
te: భారతదేశంలో, పేదరిక రేఖలను సాంప్రదాయకంగా ఆదాయం కంటే వినియోగ వ్యయం ఆధారంగా ఎందుకు అంచనా వేస్తారు?
opts: Consumption data is more reliable and accurately reported than income data, especially in rural areas.
Income data is illegal to collect in India.
Consumption expenditure does not change over time.
Government only taxes consumption, not income.
exp: Consumption expenditure is preferred over income in India because income data is subject to more fluctuations and under-reporting, particularly in the informal and agricultural sectors.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Who acts as the Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
te: నీతి ఆయోగ్ అధ్యక్షుడిగా ఎవరు వ్యవహరిస్తారు?
opts: Prime Minister of India / భారతదేశ ప్రధాన మంత్రి
exp: The Prime Minister of India serves as the Chairperson of NITI Aayog. / భారతదేశ ప్రధాన మంత్రి నీతి ఆయోగ్ అధ్యక్షుడిగా వ్యవహరిస్తారు.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Fiscal Deficit indicates:
te: ద్రవ్య లోటు దేనిని సూచిస్తుంది?
opts: Total expenditure minus total receipts excluding borrowings / మొత్తం రుణాలు మినహాయించి మొత్తం వ్యయం మరియు మొత్తం రాబడుల మధ్య వ్యత్యాసం
Revenue expenditure minus revenue receipts / రెవెన్యూ వ్యయం మరియు రెవెన్యూ రాబడుల మధ్య వ్యత్యాసం
Capital expenditure minus capital receipts / మూలధన వ్యయం మరియు మూలధన రాబడుల మధ్య వ్యత్యాసం
Total tax revenue minus non-tax revenue / మొత్తం పన్ను రాబడి మరియు పన్నుటేతర రాబడి మధ్య వ్యత్యాసం
exp: Fiscal deficit is the excess of total expenditure over total receipts excluding borrowings. / రుణాలు మినహాయించి మొత్తం రాబడుల కంటే మొత్తం వ్యయం ఎక్కువగా ఉండటాన్ని ద్రవ్య లోటు అంటారు.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India is a:
te: భారతదేశంలో వస్తు మరియు సేవల పన్ను (GST) అనేది ఒక:
exp: GST is a comprehensive indirect tax levied on the supply of goods and services in India. / GST అనేది భారతదేశంలో వస్తువులు మరియు సేవల సరఫరాపై విధించే సమగ్ర పరోక్ష పన్ను.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: When was NITI Aayog established?
te: నీతి ఆయోగ్ ఎప్పుడు ఏర్పాటు చేయబడింది?
exp: NITI Aayog was established on January 1, 2015, replacing the Planning Commission. / ప్రణాళికా సంఘం స్థానంలో నీతి ఆయోగ్ జనవరి 1, 2015న ఏర్పాటు చేయబడింది.

topic: Planning in Indian Economy: NITI Aayog, Public Finance, Fiscal Deficit, GST and Financial Sector Reforms
en: Which of the following is an example of Direct Tax in India?
te: ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో భారతదేశంలో ప్రత్యక్ష పన్నుకు ఉదాహరణ ఏది?
exp: Income Tax is a direct tax where the incidence and impact fall on the same person. / ఆదాయపు పన్ను అనేది ఒక ప్రత్యక్ష పన్ను, దీని భారం పన్ను చెల్లించే వ్యక్తిపైనే పడుతుంది.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Who is known as the Father of the Green Revolution in India?
te: भारत में हरित क्रांति के जनक के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
exp: M. S. Swaminathan is widely recognized as the scientific leader and Father of the Green Revolution in India.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: What does MSP stand for in the context of Indian agriculture?
te: भारतीय कृषि के संदर्भ में MSP का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
exp: MSP stands for Minimum Support Price, which is the rate at which the government purchases crops from farmers.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Which of the following is considered the apex institution for agricultural credit in India?
te: भारत में कृषि ऋण के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस शीर्ष संस्था माना जाता है?
exp: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) is the apex regulatory body for overall jurisdiction of agriculture credit in India.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: Abolition of Zamindari system falls under which major category of agricultural reform in India?
te: जमींदारी प्रथा का उन्मूलन भारत में कृषि सुधार की किस प्रमुख श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आता है?
exp: Abolition of intermediaries like Zamindars is a primary component of land reforms in independent India.

topic: Indian Agriculture: Land Reforms, Green Revolution, Agricultural Finance, MSP and Food Security
en: In which year was the National Food Security Act (NFSA) enacted in India?
te: भारत में राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (NFSA) किस वर्ष अधिनियमित किया गया था?
exp: The National Food Security Act (NFSA) was enacted in the year 2013 to provide subsidized food grains to approximately two-thirds of India's population.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: In which year was the first comprehensive Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) announced in independent India?
te: स्वतंत्र ভারতে మొదటి సమగ్ర పారిశ్రామిక విధాన తీర్మానం (IPR) ఏ సంవత్సరంలో ప్రకటించబడింది?
exp: The first Industrial Policy Resolution of independent India was announced on April 6, 1948.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) are currently classified based on which of the following parameters?
te: సూక్ష్మ, చిన్న మరియు మధ్యతరహా పరిశ్రమలు (MSME) ప్రస్తుతం క్రింది ఏ ప్రమాణాల ఆధారంగా వర్గీకరించబడ్డాయి?
opts: Both Investment and Annual Turnover / పెట్టుబడి మరియు వార్షిక టర్నోవర్ రెండూ
exp: Since July 2020, MSMEs are classified based on a composite criteria of both investment in plant/machinery and annual turnover.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: Which sector is generally known as the backbone of the Indian manufacturing sector in terms of employment generation and exports?
te: ఉపాధి కల్పన మరియు ఎగుమతుల పరంగా భారతీయ తయారీ రంగంలో వెన్నముకగా పిలువబడే రంగం ఏది?
opts: Public Sector Undertakings / ప్రభుత్వ రంగ సంస్థలు
exp: MSMEs play a crucial role in providing large-scale employment at lower capital cost and contribute significantly to manufacturing output and exports.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: Which city is widely regarded as the IT capital of India?
te: భారతదేశ ఐటీ రాజధానిగా ఏ నగరానికి గుర్తింపు ఉంది?
exp: Bengaluru is widely regarded as the Silicon Valley or IT capital of India due to the concentration of numerous IT companies.

topic: Indian Industry and Services: Industrial Policy, Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), IT & Tourism
en: What is the primary objective of the New Industrial Policy introduced in India in 1991?
te: 1991లో భారతదేశంలో ప్రవేశపెట్టిన నూతన పారిశ్రామిక విధానం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశ్యం ఏమిటి?
opts: Strict government control / కఠినమైన ప్రభుత్వ నియంత్రణ
Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation (LPG) / సరళీకరణ, ప్రైవేటీకరణ మరియు ప్రపంచీకరణ (LPG)
Nationalization of all industries / అన్ని పరిశ్రమల జాతీయీకరణ
Total ban on foreign direct investment / విదేశీ ప్రత్యక్ష పెట్టుబడులపై పూర్తి నిషేధం
exp: The 1991 New Industrial Policy marked a paradigm shift towards Liberalisation, Privatisation, and Globalisation (LPG) to integrate the Indian economy with the world economy.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Which of the following was the official currency of the Hyderabad State during the Nizam rule?
te: నిజాం పాలనలో హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్ర అధికారిక కరెన్సీ ఏది?
exp: Hali Sicca was the standard currency used in the Hyderabad State under the Nizams before the integration with the Indian Union.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: The traditional bonded labour system that prevailed in parts of Telangana during the Nizam era was known as:
te: నిజాం కాలంలో తెలంగాణ ప్రాంతంలో ప్రబలంగా ఉన్న సాంప్రదాయ వట్టిచాకిరీ వ్యవస్థను ఏమని పిలిచేవారు?
exp: Vetti was a form of forced and unpaid labor exacted by landlords and officials from the lower castes in the erstwhile Hyderabad State.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Which revenue system covered a major portion of the directly administered lands (Diwani lands) in the Nizam's dominions?
te: నిజాం అధీనంలోని ప్రత్యక్ష పరిపాలన భూములలో (దివానీ భూములు) ఎక్కువ భాగం ఏ రెవెన్యూ విధానం కింద ఉండేది?
exp: The Ryotwari system was predominantly implemented in the Diwani (government-administered) areas of the Hyderabad State, where cultivators paid land revenue directly to the state.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Large estates granted by the Nizams to nobles and military chiefs in lieu of services or revenue assignments were called:
te: సేవలు లేదా ఆదాయ కేటాయింపులకు ప్రతిఫలంగా నిజాంలు ప్రభువులకు మరియు సైన్యాధిపతులకు ఇచ్చిన పెద్ద ఎస్టేట్లను ఏమనేవారు?
exp: Jagirs were administrative and revenue units granted to Jagirdars by the Nizam, covering nearly one-third of the total area of Hyderabad State.

topic: Telangana Economy: Economic History under Nizam Rule and Regional Economic Disparities
en: Regional economic disparities in undivided Andhra Pradesh were prominently highlighted by which of the following committees?
te: ఉమ్మడి ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో ప్రాంతీయ ఆర్థిక అసమానతలను ఏ కమిటీ ప్రముఖంగా ఎత్తిచూపింది?
exp: The Justice Lalit Mohan Bhargava Committee (1969) was appointed by the Government of India to look into the regional imbalances and allocation of funds in undivided Andhra Pradesh.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: What is the primary indicator used to measure the total economic output of Telangana state within its boundaries?
te: తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర సరిహద్దుల్లో మొత్తం ఆర్థిక ఉత్పాదనను కొలవడానికి ఉపయోగించే ప్రాథమిక సూచిక ఏమిటి?
exp: Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) measures the monetary value of all finished goods and services made within a state over a specific period.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Which sector generally contributes the highest share to Telangana's GSDP in recent years?
te: ఇటీవలి సంవత్సరాలలో తెలంగాణ జీఎస్‌డీపీకి సాధారణంగా అత్యధిక వాటాను అందించే రంగం ఏది?
exp: The Service sector traditionally contributes the highest share to the Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) of Telangana.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Per Capita Income (PCI) of a state is calculated by dividing the total state income by:
te: ఒక రాష్ట్ర తలసరి ఆదాయం (PCI) ఆ రాష్ట్ర మొత్తం ఆదాయాన్ని దేనితో భాగించడం ద్వారా లెక్కించబడుతుంది?
exp: Per Capita Income is calculated by dividing the total income of a region (state/country) by its total population.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Structural transformation in an economy typically involves the shifting of labor and output from:
te: ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలో నిర్మాణ మార్పు (స్ట్రక్చరల్ ట్రాన్స్‌ఫర్మేషన్) సాధారణంగా కార్మిక మరియు ఉత్పాదన మార్పును దేని నుండి సూచిస్తుంది?
exp: Structural transformation generally means the transition of an economy from a predominantly agricultural base to industrial and service-based sectors.

topic: Telangana State GSDP, Per Capita Income, Structural Transformation and Sectoral Contributions
en: Which of the following is considered part of the primary sector in Telangana's economy?
te: తెలంగాణ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలో ప్రాథమిక రంగంలో భాగమైనది క్రింది వాటిలో ఏది?
exp: Agriculture, forestry, fishing, and livestock are classified under the primary sector of the economy.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: When was the Andhra Pradesh (Telangana Area) Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act enacted?
te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ (తెలంగాణ ప్రాంత) కౌలు మరియు వ్యవసాయ భూముల చట్టం ఎప్పుడు చేయబడింది?
exp: The landmark AP (Telangana Area) Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act was enacted in 1950 to protect tenants and regulate rents.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: What is the primary objective of the Dharani portal launched by the Government of Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం ప్రారంభించిన ధరణి పోర్టల్ యొక్క ప్రాథమిక ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: Integrated land records management and registration
exp: Dharani is an integrated land records management and registration portal designed to streamline land administration in Telangana.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: Which category of land tenure system was primarily abolished by the Inams Abolition Acts in the erstwhile Hyderabad state?
te: గత హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్రంలో ఇనాముల రద్దు చట్టాల ద్వారా ప్రధానంగా ఏ రకమైన భూమి యాజమాన్య వ్యవస్థ రద్దు చేయబడింది?
opts: Inam lands (tax-free or concessional land grants)
exp: Inam lands, which were granted as revenue-free or concessional tenures by rulers to individuals or institutions, were abolished to bring cultivators directly under the state.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: At the district level in Telangana, who is the principal officer responsible for land administration and revenue matters?
te: తెలంగాణలో జిల్లా స్థాయిలో భూ పరిపాలన మరియు రెవెన్యూ విషయాలకు బాధ్యత వహించే ప్రధాన అధికారి ఎవరు?
exp: The District Collector acts as the administrative head and is primarily responsible for land administration and revenue management at the district level.

topic: Land Reforms in Telangana: Tenancy Acts, Abolition of Inams, Dharani and Land Administration
en: What was the main purpose of conferring 'Protected Tenant' status under the Telangana Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, 1950?
te: తెలంగాణ కౌలు మరియు వ్యవసాయ భూముల చట్టం, 1950 కింద 'రక్షిత కౌలుదారు' హోదా కల్పించడం యొక్క ముఖ్య ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: To protect long-term tenants from illegal eviction and grant them purchase rights
To lease out government lands to industries
To abolish all forms of agriculture
exp: The Protected Tenant status aimed to safeguard long-standing tenants from arbitrary eviction by landlords and provided them with opportunities to purchase the land they cultivated.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: What is the primary objective of the 'Mission Kakatiya' program launched by the Government of Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణ ప్రభుత్వం ప్రారంభించిన 'మిషన్ కాకతీయ' కార్యక్రమం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: Restoration of minor irrigation tanks and lakes
Distribution of free seeds to farmers
exp: Mission Kakatiya aims at the restoration of minor irrigation tanks and lakes in Telangana to empower local communities and improve agriculture.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: Which of the following is the world's largest multi-stage lift irrigation project, located in Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణలో ఉన్న ఈ క్రింది వాటిలో ప్రపంచంలోనే అతిపెద్ద మల్టీ-స్టేజ్ ఎత్తిపోతల నీటిపారుదల ప్రాజెక్ట్ ఏది?
exp: The Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project is the world's largest multi-stage lift irrigation project, designed to irrigate vast areas in Telangana.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: What is the main purpose of the 'Rythu Bandhu' scheme in Telangana?
te: తెలంగాణలో 'రైతు బంధు' పథకం యొక్క ప్రధాన ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి?
opts: Crop insurance coverage for accidental death
Investment support for agriculture per acre
exp: Rythu Bandhu is an investment support scheme providing financial assistance of a specific amount per acre per season to land-owning farmers.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: The 'Rythu Bima' scheme in Telangana is primarily related to which of the following?
te: తెలంగాణలోని 'రైతు భీమా' పథకం ప్రధానంగా దేనికి సంబంధించినది?
exp: Rythu Bima is a farmer-friendly group life insurance scheme providing financial security to the family members in case of the farmer's death.

topic: Agriculture and Irrigation in Telangana: Mission Kakatiya, Kaleshwaram, Rythu Bandhu, Rythu Bima
en: On which river is the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project primarily constructed?
te: కాళేశ్వరం ఎత్తిపోతల నీటిపారుదల ప్రాజెక్ట్ ప్రధానంగా ఏ నదిపై నిర్మించబడింది?
exp: The Kaleshwaram project is constructed across the Godavari River at Medigadda in Jayashup Bhupalapally district.
